_readme: Products that must not appear on the site, whatever the price list says.
Format: "<product code>": "why". The code is the same id used everywhere
else — the barCode from the commercial team's file.
This exists because removing a product by hand does not stay removed. The
site is regenerated from data/campaign-products.csv by `npm run scrape`, and
that CSV is regenerated from whatever workbook the commercial team sends
next. Delete a row from either and the next import quietly puts it back.
An id listed here is dropped at the point products.json is written, so it
Every entry is a decision somebody made, so write down whose and why —
otherwise the list becomes a set of codes nobody dares remove.
To put a product back on the site, delete its line and run:
npm run specs && npm run bundles -- --from-feed
npm run comparisons && npm run search-index && npm run feed
